title: Balance Sheet equation fails after balanced revenue posting
description: Posted balanced journal debiting cash 100 and crediting revenue 100 yields assets 100, liabilities 0, equity 0 and equation_balanced false while P&L reports net profit 100.
reproduction: In the isolated tenant, post balanced earnings and later liability, asset and equity activity over four dates
Request P&L and Balance Sheet for each same date
Compare assets against liabilities plus equity and P&L net profit
financial_impact: Reported assets do not equal liabilities plus equity; statement is misleading for the tested periods by EGP 100 initially and EGP 60 thereafter.
root_cause: Confirmed at backend/internal/usecase/financial_report_usecase.go:261-336: query includes only active non-header asset/liability/equity accounts and sums latest ledger running balances; it does not compute current-period earnings or retained earnings. Four independently dated balanced fixtures failed by amounts equal to net profit (100, then 60).
recommended_remediation: Implement approved current-period earnings/retained-earnings treatment and reconcile report totals to the trial balance across close boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Equation holds for current-period profit fixtures
Totals reconcile to ledger under approved close policy
Fixtures cover prior-period retained earnings and cutoff dates
verification_status: Runtime verified across four independent fixture dates; source root cause confirmed
required_regression_tests: Four dated earnings/liability/asset/equity fixtures reconcile Balance Sheet, P&L, and trial balance
Test current and prior-period retained earnings and cutoff
proposed_remediation: Implement approved current-period earnings/retained-earnings treatment and reconcile report totals to the trial balance across close boundaries.
observed_result: Posted balanced journal debiting cash 100 and crediting revenue 100 yields assets 100, liabilities 0, equity 0 and equation_balanced false while P&L reports net profit 100.

title: Manual journal UI omits JSONB attachments and API rejects request
description: UI sent valid balanced entry without attachments; PostgreSQL returned HTTP 400 invalid input syntax for type json. Same authenticated request with attachments: [] returned 201.
reproduction: Open journal form
Enter description and balanced lines
Save with default attachments
financial_impact: Default manual journal workflow is blocked.
root_cause: Nil JSON raw message reaches JSONB insert; form sends no attachments property.
recommended_remediation: Default attachments to valid empty JSON and regression-test browser submission.
acceptance_criteria: Default UI can create a draft without manual JSON edits
Valid attachments persist and post
Malformed JSON receives controlled validation
required_regression_tests: Submit browser form with omitted attachments and verify valid JSON default
Submit explicit [] and verify persisted JSONB
Keep malformed attachment JSON rejected
proposed_remediation: Default attachments to valid empty JSON and regression-test browser submission.
observed_result: UI sent valid balanced entry without attachments; PostgreSQL returned HTTP 400 invalid input syntax for type json. Same authenticated request with attachments: [] returned 201.

title: Auto-posting normalizer absorbs material imbalance into final line
description: Runtime probe confirmed Dr 100 / Cr 90 is normalized by increasing the final revenue credit 90→100 (EGP 10). With valid JSON and schema-valid manual entry type, the normalized lines persisted via the journal/ledger repository as a posted 100/100 journal with two ledger rows. Actual PostSupplierInvoiceEntry did not persist because nil JSONB attachments fail first; reverse Dr 100 / Cr 110 is rejected by line validation. No configured materiality cap exists; downstream line/NUMERIC constraints bound what reaches persistence. Callers include payroll and sales, COGS, supplier invoice/payment, payroll, and depreciation paths.
reproduction: Run the isolated overlay test with supplier event lines Dr 100 / Cr 90
Observe the actual supplier method fail on nil JSONB attachments before insert
Call normalizer and observe final revenue credit change 90→100
Persist normalized lines via repository with attachments [] and entry_type manual; observe posted journal and two ledger rows
Try reverse Dr 100 / Cr 110; observe repository validation rejection
financial_impact: Source calculation error is hidden by changing the last account amount; conditional repository proof shows wrong account attribution can reach posted ledger records. The production automatic supplier method is independently blocked before persistence by FIN-008, so that exact method was not shown posting the altered entry.
root_cause: normalizeBalancedLines at backend/internal/usecase/auto_posting_engine.go:633-660 changes final line for every rounded difference above 0.009 instead of rejecting material imbalance.
recommended_remediation: Reject material imbalances. Permit only explicitly recorded, bounded rounding to an approved rounding account under documented policy.
acceptance_criteria: Material imbalance fails before journal persistence
Only approved bounded rounding is allowed and separately auditable
Positive and reverse imbalance tests preserve one-sided line constraints and cannot silently alter business accounts
verification_status: Behavior and conditional repository persistence verified in disposable DB; actual automatic supplier-method persistence blocked by FIN-008
required_regression_tests: Dr100/Cr90 must fail automatic posting or be recorded as explicit approved rounding
Dr100/Cr110 must fail without a two-sided line
Verify no material difference changes a business account silently
proposed_remediation: Reject material imbalances. Permit only explicitly recorded, bounded rounding to an approved rounding account under documented policy.
observed_result: Runtime probe confirmed Dr 100 / Cr 90 is normalized by increasing the final revenue credit 90→100 (EGP 10). With valid JSON and schema-valid manual entry type, the normalized lines persisted via the journal/ledger repository as a posted 100/100 journal with two ledger rows. Actual PostSupplierInvoiceEntry did not persist because nil JSONB attachments fail first; reverse Dr 100 / Cr 110 is rejected by line validation.

title: Failed auto-post may leave a draft journal requiring review
description: Auto-posting creates a draft in CreateJournalEntry, then AppendEntry starts the posting transaction. A failure before posting commit can leave a draft. Ledger insertion and posted status are in the same PostEntryTx transaction in the inspected path.
reproduction: Failure injection not run
financial_impact: A draft may require reconciliation/retry; no posted-without-ledger case was shown in the inspected path.
root_cause: Draft creation and posting are distinct transactions, while ledger insertion and posted status are atomic together.
recommended_remediation: Define a retry/alert policy for drafts that remain after automatic-posting errors; retain idempotency and reconciliation.
acceptance_criteria: Failures leave a detectable state
Retry/reconciliation is idempotent
Posted status and ledger rows are atomic
required_regression_tests: Inject failure after draft creation and before posting commit
Verify draft is discoverable/recoverable
Retry and assert no duplicate ledger rows
proposed_remediation: Define a retry/alert policy for drafts that remain after automatic-posting errors; retain idempotency and reconciliation.
observed_result: Auto-posting creates a draft in CreateJournalEntry, then AppendEntry starts the posting transaction. A failure before posting commit can leave a draft. Ledger insertion and posted status are in the same PostEntryTx transaction in the inspected path.

Applied rule and rate are auditable

Test tax rounding and persisted rule version
Reconcile calculated order tax to accounting journal
proposed_remediation: Use approved jurisdictional tax configuration and persist applied rule for audit.

title: Automatic journals fail insertion because JSONB attachments are nil
observed_result: Automatic method returns error before journal persistence because nil JSON raw message reaches JSONB insert.
